message.content: {"note_claim": "The video is from the October 8, 2022 explosion on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.", "reason": "The Wikipedia page confirms the date, location, and event described in the note."}

parsed.note_claim: The video is from the October 8, 2022 explosion on the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to Crimea.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The 2022 Crimean Bridge explosion occurred on 8 October 2022, at 6:07 a.m. A fire broke out on the Crimean Bridge as a result of an explosion of a bomb that had been loaded onto a truck.
